title: http3(quiche): always timeout when reuse a http3 connection in pool which timeout once
body:
<!-- Only file bugs here! Ask questions on the mailing lists https://curl.se/mail/

### I did this
- send http3(quiche) request with multi interface continuously, and try reusing connection in the pool, the major code like this: 
```c++
curl_multi_setopt(multi_handle, CURLMOPT_MAXCONNECTS, 10L);
std::vector<std::string> url_list; 
...
while(true) {
    for(auto url : url_list) {
        curl_easy_setopt(http_handle, CURLOPT_DEBUGFUNCTION, mycurl_debug);
        curl_easy_setopt(http_handle, CURLOPT_ALTSVC, "altsvc_cache.txt"); // try http3
        ...
        curl_multi_add_handle(multi_handle, http_handle);
        do {
            curl_multi_wait(multi_handle, NULL, 0, 10, &numfds);
            curl_multi_perform(multi_handle, &still_running);
            mycurl_process(multi_handle); // output curl info here, then call multi_remove() and easy_cleanup()
        } while(still_running); // force sync request
        sleep(5); 
    }
}
```
- if the connection is http/1.1 or http/2, it will work well
- however, when using http/3 from altsvc, if the request was failed because of timeout, thIS http3 connection still remain in pool
- after that, all requests with the same domain will try reusing the http3 connection in pool, and always get a timeout error
